cites.quote: Given more than 20 patients, when staff open the patient list, then each page shows 20 patients.
The patient list still shows 20 patients per page.

findings.text: S-4 AC1 says each page shows 20 patients whenever there are more than 20. A correct build with, for example, 25 patients has a last page of 5, so this criterion would fail a correct implementation.
